details:
ARC LUNA

AI-Assisted Lunar Exploration and Space Mission Intelligence Platform

Project Abstract

ARC LUNA is an innovative space technology platform designed to support lunar exploration education, scientific visualization, and conceptual space mission research. The project integrates interactive 3D planetary visualization, geospatial data processing, terrain analysis, and educational spacecraft simulations into a unified digital environment.

The platform enables users to explore the Earth, Moon, and Sun through interactive 3D visualizations and investigate selected lunar coordinates using geographical and terrain-related information. Its proposed Landing Intelligence module focuses on important lunar surface characteristics, including elevation, slope, roughness, crater distribution, and illumination conditions, to help users understand the factors involved in identifying potentially suitable lunar landing regions.

ARC LUNA also incorporates educational mission-control simulations, conceptual rocket design, and AI-assisted research capabilities to make complex space science concepts more accessible.

The project is being developed using React.js, JavaScript, Three.js, Python, FastAPI, and scientific computing and geospatial processing libraries. It is designed with modular architecture to support future integration of NASA and ISRO scientific datasets.

The main objective of ARC LUNA is to bridge the gap between space science education and interactive scientific research by providing an accessible environment for exploring lunar terrain, understanding space missions, and encouraging innovation in aerospace technology.

Project Domain: Space Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Aerospace, Geospatial Analysis, and Scientific Visualization.

Expected Outcome: An interactive educational and research-support platform for lunar exploration and conceptual space mission analysis.
